tools.name: get_consent_state
tools.description: Read the visitor's current cookie-consent state on this site. Necessary cookies are always on. Reports whether the visitor has decided yet and the on/off state of analytics, ads and personalized ads. By design there is no tool to grant consent: consent is given by a human on the banner.

tools.name: get_current_plan
tools.description: Read the plan on the product page the user is viewing right now: the same facts as get_plan_details for that product, priced as shown on the page. Use when the user asks about "this plan" or the page they are on. No input. Present only the returned fields; never invent carrier, speed or coverage details that are not in the result. price is the full fixed price. State validity_clock, expires_on and notice whenever they are present.

tools.name: get_locale_state
tools.description: Read the current site locale: UI language, region and the active /{language-region}/ bucket of the page the user is on.

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Full facts for one e-eSIM plan by product id: coverage list, data and speed rules (daily allowance, reduced speed, fair use), validity clock, expiry date, notice, carrier, price, reviews and link — quoted in the customer's bucket or currency when given. Present only the returned fields; never invent carrier, speed or coverage details that are not in the result. price is the full fixed price. State validity_clock, expires_on and notice whenever they are present.

product_id.description: Product id from search_esim_plans or recommend_plan.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Defaults to the language of the page the user is on.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 override. Defaults to the currency shown on the page the user is on.

tools.name: get_shop_facts
tools.description: How e-eSIM works, in the shop's own words: delivery and installation, device requirements, payment methods, money-back guarantee, top-up, hotspot, support and company details. Use for any "how / when / what if" question that is not about one specific plan.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Turn a trip into up to three plan recommendations: countries (1-5, any language), number of days and how much data the traveller uses. Each fit carries the full plan facts, the total price for the whole trip and a one-sentence reason built only from catalogue facts. Use this first whenever the user describes a trip rather than asks for a list.

countries.description: Countries or regions of the trip, any language.

usage.description: light ≈ 0.5 GB/day (maps, messaging), normal ≈ 1.5 GB/day (social, some video), heavy ≈ 4 GB/day (video, hotspot). Default normal.

gb_per_day.description: Overrides usage with an explicit daily need in GB.

budget.description: Optional maximum total for the trip, in the result currency.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Defaults to the language of the page the user is on.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 override. Defaults to the currency shown on the page the user is on.

tools.name: reject_non_essential_cookies
tools.description: Opt the visitor out of all non-essential cookies (analytics, ads, personalized ads) and close the consent banner. Necessary cookies remain. Records a refusal only; it can never grant consent - that is a human decision by design. Use when the user wants to decline tracking.

tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Find e-eSIM eSIM plans for one destination or several (countries or regions, any language). Returns the best-value plans first with full facts, coverage lists and a direct link; multi-country plans that include the destination are returned too and marked covers_via. Use when a user wants mobile data abroad; use recommend_plan when they describe a whole trip. Present only returned facts. price is the full fixed plan price, never per day or per GB. Every All You Can Surf grade has a daily full-speed allowance, then a reduced speed - never call a plan uncapped. Mention validity_clock, expires_on and notice when present. Use url and all_plans_url exactly.

destination.description: Country or region in any language, e.g. "Thailand", "Japon", "Europa", or a 2-letter ISO code. For a city, pass its country.

destinations.description: Several countries for one trip; only plans covering ALL of them are returned. Overrides destination.

min_days.description: Only plans valid for at least this many days.

limit.description: How many plans to return, best value first. Default 10; all_plans_url always lists everything.

sort.description: value = best price per GB delivered / cheapest All You Can Surf per day first (default); price = cheapest first; data = most data first.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Defaults to the language of the page the user is on.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 override. Defaults to the currency shown on the page the user is on.

tools.name: set_currency
tools.description: Switch the displayed currency by ISO 4217 code such as "EUR", "USD" or "GBP". Currency follows the region, so the site navigates to the matching region in the user's current language.

tools.name: set_language
tools.description: Switch the site to a supported language-region bucket such as "de-de" or "en-gb" and navigate to that locale; prices then show in that region's currency. Call get_locale_state first to see the current bucket.

tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Hand the customer to the e-eSIM shop to buy one plan. Returns buy_url (the product page where they tap Buy now and pay securely — card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal; there is no discount-code field) plus the plan name and price in the customer's bucket or currency. No account needed; the eSIM is emailed right after payment. There is no in-chat order tracking. Hand the customer to buy_url exactly as returned, as one clear link; the customer pays on that page. No cart is created here and there is no order tracking or discount code.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Defaults to the language of the page the user is on.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. "en-gb", "de-de". Wins over language; prices and links are quoted in it.

currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 override. Defaults to the currency shown on the page the user is on.
